# Databases

This area groups the foundational databases and registries that supply data to the Danish healthcare system and clinical quality programs like the Akut Kirurgi Databasen. It covers historical clinical registers that shaped emergency surgery research, national government registries that provide patient identification and organizational boundaries, and specialized healthcare databases that supply anesthesiology and laboratory records. Together, these data sources enable the precise definition of target populations, the calculation of clinical quality indicators, and the monitoring of real-world practices in acute abdominal surgery.

## Pages

- [[entities/databases/clinical/index|Clinical]] — Foundational clinical databases in Denmark, including historical registers that served as predecessors to current national platforms for emergency surgery research and quality monitoring.
- [[entities/databases/government/index|Government]] — National government registries supplying administrative and structural data, such as civil registration for patient identification and organizational registers for defining hospital department boundaries.
- [[entities/databases/healthcare/index|Healthcare]] — Specialized national healthcare databases providing supplementary clinical and laboratory records, such as anesthesiology classifications and lab results, used to calculate quality indicators.
